portedInvariants: GRN prefix and yearly seven-digit sequence
accepted and placed line emits one warehouse event
procurement article follows the receiving line into warehouse stock
manufacturer series is recorded during incoming control and remains distinct from GRN
first inspection shortfall of a paid line becomes a -Д procurement backorder
unit mass weighed at incoming control as 1, 10 or 100 pieces and the expiry date follow the line into warehouse stock

an accepted line returns to the supplier as one act per line with a shared reason: status «Возврат» or back «В пути» for a replacement, the returned quantity is written off its ГРН + ПАКЕТ lot only when the lot is on stock
a delivery splits into manufacturer batches before its first inspection, each its own line, ГРН and verdict; the batches' shortfall against the order goes to the backorder
an accepted line splits into packages sharing its ГРН before placement, the packages summing to КОЛ-ВО ФАКТ
acts ВК, АН, РК and РИ are numbered per day and issued by the verdict, a missing one on re-inspection; one of the document and factual quantities stands for the other
